title: What makes a perfect beach day?
text: Using 2021–2023 daytime weather observations (9 AM–5 PM) from NOAA’s National Centers for Environmental Information for Sarasota-Bradenton, FL, we count an hour as beach-friendly when temperatures are comfortable (75–90°F), there is no rain, winds are mild (\(\le\) 15 mph), and skies are at least partly sunny.
